task_instance: Create a complete interview kit for a 'Senior Backend Engineer' role: 5 role competencies, a 5-round panel assignment mapping interviewers to competencies, a question bank per competency (behavioral + situational questions with follow-up probes), a 1-4 scoring rubric with descriptors, and a structured debrief template with a decision section.
evidence: Produced interview_kit_senior_backend_engineer.md in the work directory containing: (1) 5 role competencies (Technical Depth, Problem Solving & Debugging, Code Quality & Engineering Craft, Communication & Collaboration, Ownership & Leadership); (2) a panel assignment table mapping 5 interviewers/rounds to competencies; (3) a question bank with 2 behavioral + 1 situational question plus follow-up probes for each of the 5 competencies (verified via grep: 10 'Behavioral:' entries, 5 'Situational:' entries, 5 '### N.' competency headers); (4) a 1-4 scorecard with clear descriptors for each level (Strong No/No/Yes/Strong Yes); (5) a debrief template with a scores summary table, discussion points, and a decision checklist (Strong Hire/Hire/No Hire/Strong No Hire) plus rationale and next-steps fields. This is a pure content-generation task (writing structured text/markdown) requiring no external tools, network access, or credentials, so it was fully achievable and verified by inspecting the file's structure and content directly (wc -l, grep for section headers and question-type counts).
